# EventHub API 1.0.0 — endpoints (generated by npm run api:spec, do not edit)

Servers: https://api.eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/api, http://localhost:3001/api

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/register` | Register a new user |
| POST | `/auth/login` | Log in with existing credentials |
| GET | `/auth/me` | Get the currently authenticated user |
| GET | `/bookings` | List all bookings |
| POST | `/bookings` | Create a booking (buy tickets) |
| GET | `/bookings/ref/{ref}` | Look up a booking by reference code |
| GET | `/bookings/{id}` | Get a single booking by ID |
| DELETE | `/bookings/{id}` | Cancel a booking |
| GET | `/events` | List all events |
| POST | `/events` | Create a new event |
| GET | `/events/{id}` | Get a single event by ID |
| PUT | `/events/{id}` | Update an event |
| DELETE | `/events/{id}` | Delete an event |
| GET | `/health` | API health check |
| GET | `/config` | Get public feature flags |
